messages:
Nina (sec-eng): Heads up

Customer 'Stonebridge' requested a compliance bundle for the upcoming security review: RBAC change logs, KMS unwrap events, HSM attestation, SIEM ingest proof, and a vuln triage summary. Can infra pull samples?
Ibrahim (infra): I can grab RBAC history + drift-check outputs. Which time range?
Nina (sec-eng): 90 days. Also include one canned example of dual-approval for role elevation.
Clara (customer-sre): Stonebridge also wants KMS unwraps correlated to request_id and a signed HSM attestation if possible.
Jon (platform): We have an export script for KMS audit events; must redact tenant ids and key material. Example: `./tools/export_kms_audit --from 2024-11-01 --to 2025-02-28 --redact > stone_kms.jsonl`
Ibrahim (infra): RBAC sample will include actor, target, prev_roles, new_roles, approval_ids. Example: {"ts":"2025-02-05T08:12:00Z","actor":"svc-deploy","target":"zoe","prev_roles":["viewer"],"new_roles":["deployer"],"approval_ids":["appr_321"]} (we'll redact usernames per policy)
Nina (sec-eng): Good. For SIEM proof include index metadata and one sample event with correlation_id preserved. Jon, can you provide a Splunk manifest?
Jon (platform): Yes 

I'll export index stats and a sampled event set. We'll preserve correlation_id and obfuscate tenant_id.
Clara (customer-sre): Stonebridge compliance might ask for a vendor-signed attestation referencing the export window. Can we request that from the HSM vendor?
Jon (platform): We have a current vendor attestation PDF. Requesting a stamped attestation could take 48-72 hours. We'll include the PDF and note the lead time.
Nina (sec-eng): Action items: Ibrahim -> RBAC export + diagram; Jon -> KMS export + vendor attestation + SIEM manifest; I -> executive summary + redaction checklist + assemble. Clara -> coordinate the review call.
evidence-bot: Checklist created: security.packet.stonebridge.3425009999 (rbac_export, kms_unwraps, siem_manifest, hsm_attest, vuln_timeline). Assigned to: Nina/Ibrahim/Jon. Deadline: 2025-03-08 09:00 UTC.
Ibrahim (infra): Starting exports now, will upload to s3://compliance-evidence/stonebridge-3425009999/ and DM links.
Jon (platform): KMS export uploaded (redacted sample) and vendor attestation attached. DM sent to Nina.
Nina (sec-eng): I'll draft the exec summary and redaction rules. Please flag any edge-case fields that look PII-y.
Clara (customer-sre): Please aim to have a draft shared before the call so Stonebridge can review ahead of time.
Nina (sec-eng): Will do. Thanks team :thumbsup:
